channel.title: OpEdNews (OEN) – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from OpEdNews (OEN) – Bias and Credibility (fullfact.org)

item.title: ‘I’m just kicking myself’: How a fake garden seeds offer on Facebook almost cost a Full Fact reader over £500 – Full Fact
item.description: Sandy saw what looked like a real bargain from Wickes - and only realised it was bogus when she was alerted by her bank.

item.title: Labour MP’s claim that one in six Scots are ‘stuck on an NHS waiting list’ is not reliable – Full Fact
item.description: This figure, which we’ve heard from Scottish Labour before, appears to combine waits for multiple types of treatment in Scotland—but some patients may be waiting for multiple appointments.

item.title: No, Keir Starmer didn’t threaten to embarrass Rupert Lowe on national TV – Full Fact
item.description: Posts being shared on Facebook detail a fabricated exchange between the Prime Minister and Restore Britain MP Rupert Lowe in parliament.

item.title: Post promoting Cadbury Dairy Milk box deal is fake – Full Fact
item.description: Cadbury’s parent company, Mondelez, confirmed it’s not a real offer from the chocolate retailer.

item.title: Katie Hopkins didn’t confront Muslim MPs in the House of Commons – Full Fact
item.description: A Facebook post claims Katie Hopkins ‘unleashed hell’ during a speech in the House of Commons, but this did not happen.

item.title: How Full Fact will be covering the 2026 elections – Full Fact
item.description: Full Fact is undertaking an ambitious range of activities to ensure that you, our audience are as well informed as possible.

item.title: False rumour spreads on social media about Plymouth hotel housing asylum seekers – Full Fact
item.description: Social media posts have falsely claimed that the Duke of Cornwall hotel in Plymouth is being refurbished to house asylum seekers.

item.title: Why is TikTok penalising content designed to highlight misinformation? – Full Fact
item.description: Recently, we received a community guidelines violation from TikTok on a video featuring practical advice on how to avoid misinformation related to conflict in the Middle East. As a result, the video was removed and is no longer accessible to viewers.

item.title: ‘Eid Mubarak’ chocolate box is not being sold by Cadbury – Full Fact
item.description: Claims that Cadbury is selling a chocolate box saying ‘Eid Mubarak’ are misleading. Although such a product is sold on eBay by an independent seller, it is not produced by Cadbury.

item.title: Video showing Iranian soldiers boarding tanker is from 2019 – Full Fact
item.description: Old footage of Iran seizing a British-flagged tanker in July 2019 has been circulating online with misleading captions claiming Iran has captured a US ship in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Did Reform UK break its promises on council tax? – Full Fact
item.description: We’ve taken a look at what Reform UK and Nigel Farage said about council tax during last year’s local elections, as well as how Reform-led councils actually compare to others in England on council tax rises.

item.title: Fake image of Earth from Artemis II mission shared online – Full Fact
item.description: The picture, which appears to depict Earth as seen from the window of the Orion spacecraft, has almost certainly been generated with AI.

item.title: Sky News corrects report about the US and the Geneva Conventions – Full Fact
item.description: The US did sign and ratify the original four Geneva Conventions but didn’t ratify some later protocols.

item.title: Old videos of Gaza and Turkey earthquake shared with false claims they show destruction in Tel Aviv – Full Fact
item.description: A compilation video featuring old clips from Gaza and an earthquake in Turkey has been shared online with false claims it shows recent scenes in Israel.

item.title: ‘Photo from Artemis II’ of moon crater with Earth in background is fake – Full Fact
item.description: A viral picture claiming to show the moon's Orientale Basin photographed by the Artemis II crew isn’t genuine. It contains an AI watermark and does not match real NASA photos of the crater.
